jobs.name: rabbit-family-source
jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Image 1 is the NEW authoritative Sidefolk Mascot Brand Guide; image 2 is the already-approved Mochi rabbit identity to preserve. Faithfully match its soft white round head, two tall white rabbit ears with large navy #0F2D5B tips, two navy bead eyes with small white catchlights, tiny navy oval nose, aqua/mint scarf with one short rounded hanging end. No mouth, visor, robot features or fur strands. Polished smooth soft-3D silicone/porcelain toy rendering as in image 1, not photographic. Core palette white, navy #0F2D5B, aqua #2ED4D9, coral #FF7B6B, mint #7DD3A7, light blue #93C5FD. Exact character identity and proportions are critical. Actual fully transparent background, opaque character surfaces, clean narrow antialiased edges. Absolutely no background glows, haze, ground plane, cast shadows, icon tile, extruded edge, bevel, corner mask, container, scene, watermark, labels or text. Asset type: primary full-color logo artwork WITHOUT wordmark. A compact family composition faithful to the guide's PRIMARY LOGO panel: Mochi bunny largest in the center foreground, both full tall navy-tipped ears completely visible, aqua scarf visible at the bottom, one white paw lifted. Three smaller round helpers peek and cuddle around it: mint Seed left/front with happy face and simple little leaves, blue Byte rear-left with subtle round navy glasses, coral Pip on the right with small swept tuft and smiling face. Keep helpers at about one-third to one-half the bunny's head size. One compact balanced connected group, no floating hearts or accent rays. All characters and body parts fully in frame with generous transparent margins. No lettering.
